Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
DOC-0028 2026-09-04
MEMORANDUM
Date: 2026-09-04
To: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA queue coordinators
From: PERSON-0019, TEAM-0001
Subject: Name the Reviewer Before the Shift Ends
Decision: When a task is presented for coordination in the awaiting review
category, the owning team's shift lead must name a reviewer within the same
shift. This DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA rule concerns reviewer scheduling and
the completeness of the appointment record.
The receiving reviewer must confirm availability. Put the person's name,
expected discussion time, and substitute contact on the appointment sheet. A
team label alone is not a reviewer name, and an open calendar interval is not
acceptance of the appointment.
If the intended reviewer is unavailable, the shift lead asks the duty chair for
coverage before handover. Retain the initial request and the reason for
changing the appointment. The incoming desk needs a concrete receiving role
and next contact time, not an instruction to find somebody later.
The cabin example uses DEMO-AIR-0007, ISSUE-0089, and TASK-0939 as
locating references. Keep gathering requests associated with TASK-0237
separate from the appointment sheet, and retain TASK-0238 only in its own
reference space when needed.
Implementation: PERSON-0019 will brief the roster clerks on 2026-09-05. The
program chair will review the appointment layout on 2026-09-11, focusing on
whether a shift lead can identify the receiving reviewer and fallback without
consulting an earlier shift's private notes.
D. Worker 0017
Demo Worker 0019, Demo Team 01
